clips.title: The story
paras: At the Lakeshire docks, Hilary cries over the necklace she lost in Lake Everstill.

Hilary waits in tears by the Lakeshire pier, afraid her father will be angry. She dropped the necklace he gave her into Lake Everstill, and hopes someone brave will dive in to find it. Gnoll invasions and Blackrock orc warbands press upon Lakeshire, but children there still face troubles of their own.
